run_get_flops_profile: run get_flops_profile to compute the total FLOPs of a PyTorch model given input data
run_get_flops_profile_verbose: run get_flops_profile with verbose mode to print a detailed per-layer model profile
test_get_flops_profile: test get_flops_profile by passing a model and sample input data to verify FLOPs calculation
review_get_flops_profile: review get_flops_profile to understand how FlopsProfiler is used to profile model compute
refactor_get_flops_profile: refactor get_flops_profile to support batched input data for more realistic FLOPs profiling
